"Role and Persona
Act as the Lead Game Director, Principal Engine Architect, and Senior AI Programmer for the RAGE (Rockstar Advanced Game Engine). Your objective is to architect the core systems, game loop, and narrative structures for Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6). You will provide detailed C++ engine logic, system design documents, and backend architecture blueprints based on the following master specification.
​1. World and Environment
​Setting: The state of Leonida, featuring a sprawling, highly dense recreation of Vice City and surrounding areas like Port Gellhorn and the Leonida Keys.
​Dynamic Weather @COMMENT_BODY@ Physics: Implement a volumetric cloud system and advanced weather events, including tropical storms and hurricanes. Rain must create persistent puddles, and wind physics must dynamically affect vegetation, debris, and character hair.  
​Density @COMMENT_BODY@ Navigation: Roads are approximately 15% narrower than previous iterations to realistically simulate rush-hour traffic density. Parallax mapping must be used to simulate 3D interiors for buildings when viewed from the outside.  
​2. Protagonists @COMMENT_BODY@ Narrative Dynamics
​Dual Protagonists: The narrative centers on a Bonnie-and-Clyde dynamic between Jason Duval (an ex-military drug runner) and Lucia Caminos (a fighter recently released from prison).
​Relationship System: Code a bond system where shared activities (such as going to the gym, shopping, or playing pool) strengthen their relationship.
​Co-op Mechanics: Implement real-time role swapping, allowing players to switch seats dynamically during car chases so one can drive while the other shoots.  
​3. Core Gameplay Systems
​Combat: Remove default auto-aim. Implement a \"Focus\" ability that slows time and highlights enemy weak points, similar to Dead Eye. Enforce heavy weapon weight and recoil to make sustained fire difficult, and restrict players to a visually accurate, limited weapon loadout UI.  
​Vehicle Mechanics:
​Fuel System: Vehicles consume fuel and must be refueled at gas stations (which also repair damage) or charging stations for EVs.  
​Trunk Inventory: Every personal vehicle must have a fully functional trunk to store weapons, duffel bags, or hide NPCs/bodies.
​Stealing @COMMENT_BODY@ Hijacking: Introduce a lockpicking minigame for parked cars that can trigger alarms, and active quick-time events for hijacking where drivers or passengers may fight back.  
​Crime @COMMENT_BODY@ Heat System: Overhaul the wanted level. Crimes no longer trigger automatic police alerts. Implement a \"Heat\" system where solid white stars denote direct visual contact by law enforcement. Ensure buildings have multiple exits to support dynamic escape routing.  
​Economy: Separate player funds into three distinct pools: a secure Bank Balance (managed via the in-game BuckMe app), physical Cash (which is lost upon death or arrest), and Loot carried in duffel bags that must be fenced. Implement a Criminal Profile System that tracks player violence to dictate NPC hostility and police severity.
​4. Technical Architecture
​Performance Targets: Optimize the engine to target 1440p at 30 FPS on base current-gen consoles, utilizing Ray-Traced Global Illumination (RTGI) and ray-traced shadows.
​Backend Infrastructure: Design an event-driven microservices architecture using tools like Kafka or RabbitMQ to handle real-time matchmaking, live events, and instant relay of in-game triggers (like police chases or car crashes) across millions of concurrent users.  
​AI Behaviors: Use reinforcement learning and behavior trees for dynamic NPC responses.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

Let's write CSS strongly GTA-esque: pink #ff2e88, cyan #25e6ff, yellow #ffd166, dark #0a0710. Condensed uppercase.

Title screen: big VI split with gradient, "LEONIDA DREAMING", artwork simulated via CSS gradient and a canvas? We can show live game render behind title. Title overlay with lines.

Let's build.

input.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover" />
<meta name="theme-color" content="#08060d" />
<title>GTA VI — Leonida Dreaming</title>
<style>
:root{
  --pink:#ff2f8e; --pink2:#ff7ab8; --cyan:#38e8ff; --gold:#ffd166; --red:#ff3b30;
  --ink:#08060d; --panel:rgba(12,9,20,.82); --line:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --font:'Arial Narrow','Roboto Condensed','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;
  --display:'Arial Black','Impact','Haettenschweiler',sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#06040a;color:#fff;font-family:var(--font);-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;overscroll-behavior:none}
canvas{display:block}
#app{position:fixed;inset:0}
.hidden{display:none!important}
button{font-family:var(--font);cursor:pointer}
kbd{display:inline-block;min-width:20px;padding:2px 6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);border-radius:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);font-family:var(--font);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.5)}

/* ---------------- boot ---------------- */
#boot{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:#06040a;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:opacity .6s}
#boot .loader{text-align:center}
#boot .bars{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:flex-end;height:52px;margin-bottom:18px;justify-content:center}
#boot .bar{width:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--cyan),var(--pink));animation:bounce 1s infinite alternate;border-radius:2px}
@keyframes bounce{from{height:12px;opacity:.5}to{height:52px;opacity:1}}
#boot h1{font-family:var(--display);letter-spacing:.18em;font-size:18px;margin:0 0 6px}
#boot p{color:#8d86a0;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}

/* ---------------- title ---------------- */
#title{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:120;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding:clamp(18px,4vw,54px);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(5,3,10,.94) 0%,rgba(5,3,10,.72) 44%,rgba(5,3,10,.05) 72%,rgba(5,3,10,.35) 100%);
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .8s}
#title.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
#title .brandRow{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:24px}
.brand{position:relative;line-height:.78}
.brand .gta{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(26px,4.1vw,48px);letter-spacing:.06em;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 4px 0 #1b0a2a}
.brand .six{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(120px,17vw,250px);letter-spacing:-.07em;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff 0%,#ffd2e9 18%,#ff2f8e 52%,#b318ff 82%,#25e6ff 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 34px rgba(255,47,142,.38));margin-left:-6px}
.brand .vi{position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-8px;writing-mode:vertical-rl;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.38em;color:var(--cyan);opacity:.85}
.titleTag{margin-top:22px;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(20px,3.1vw,38px);letter-spacing:.14em;color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase}
.titleTag em{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold)}
.titleSub{max-width:480px;color:#c9c3d8;font-size:clamp(11px,1.25vw,14px);line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.07em;margin-top:10px;text-transform:uppercase}
.titleBottom{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.titlePlay{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start}
#btnPlay{padding:16px 46px;font-family:var(--display);font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.16em;border:0;color:#0a0710;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#fff,#ffd0e5 40%,var(--pink));box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.6),0 12px 44px rgba(255,47,142,.45);
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,97% 0,100% 100%,3% 100%);transition:transform .15s,filter .15s}
#btnPlay:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.08)}
#btnPlay small{display:block;font-family:var(--font);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.24em;margin-top:4px;opacity:.6}
.titleHint{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8e87a2}
.titleMeta{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8e87a2}
.titleMeta b{color:#fff}
.titleMeta .dot{width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--pink);display:inline-block;margin-right:7px;vertical-align:middle}
.savechip{padding:9px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#aaa2bb}
.savechip b{color:var(--gold)}
.disclaimer{position:absolute;bottom:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#5f586f}

/* ---------------- HUD ---------------- */
#hud{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:20;opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s}
#hud.show{opacity:1}
.hudTop{position:absolute;top:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top));left:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-left));right:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-right));display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px}
.loc{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#d8d2e6;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000}
.loc .pin{width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--cyan);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.loc .clock{color:var(--gold)}
.loc .weather{color:#bdb5d0}
.wanted{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;padding:7px 11px;background:rgba(8,6,14,.5);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:3px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.star{opacity:.18;transition:.25s;filter:grayscale(1)}
.star svg{width:22px;height:22px;display:block}
.star.on{opacity:1;filter:none}
.star.white{color:#fff;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(255,255,255,.95))}
.star.red{color:#ff2f3e;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255,47,62,.9))}
.star.pulse{animation:starpulse .55s infinite alternate}
@keyframes starpulse{to{transform:scale(1.13)}}

.radarWrap{position:absolute;left:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-left));bottom:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));width:198px;height:198px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(6,5,11,.88);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6),inset 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.8);overflow:hidden}
#radar{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.radarRing{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(56,232,255,.12)}
.radarCompass{position:absolute;top:5px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--cyan);text-shadow:0 0 8px #000}

.status{position:absolute;left:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-left));bottom:calc(226px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));width:198px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.meter{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.meter label{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em;width:36px;color:#a79fb9;text-transform:uppercase}
.meter .track{flex:1;height:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.13);overflow:hidden;transform:skewX(-18deg)}
.meter .fill{height:100%;width:100%;transition:width .2s}
.fill.hp{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff3b58,#ff8a5b)}
.fill.ar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#38e8ff,#7a9cff)}
.fill.fo{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd166,#ff2f8e)}
.meter .val{font-size:9px;color:#d6d0e5;width:24px;text-align:right;letter-spacing:.05em}
.purse{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:7px;padding-top:7px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.purse b{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.purse .cash{color:#7dff9c}.purse .bank{color:var(--cyan)}.purse .loot{color:var(--gold)}
#weaponHud{position:absolute;right:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-right));bottom:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));text-align:right;min-width:210px}
.weaponName{font-family:var(--display);font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;text-shadow:0 2px 10px #000}
.weaponAmmo{font-family:var(--display);font-size:30px;letter-spacing:.03em;line-height:1}
.weaponAmmo span{font-size:14px;color:#9c95ad}
.loadout{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:9px}
.slot{width:44px;height:30px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:rgba(9,7,16,.55);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#8e87a2;position:relative;transition:.15s}
.slot.active{border-color:var(--pink);color:#fff;background:rgba(255,47,142,.16);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,47,142,.3)}
.slot small{position:absolute;top:-7px;left:2px;font-size:7px;color:#6f6880}
.roleTag{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px}
.roleTag .swap{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,47,142,.25);border:1px solid rgba(255,47,142,.5);padding:1px 5px;margin-left:5px}

#missionHud{position:absolute;top:calc(58px + env(safe-area-inset-top));right:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-right));width:min(300px,42vw);text-align:right;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000}
#missionHud .kicker{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.28em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px}
#missionHud .obj{font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#fff;font-weight:700}
#missionHud .dist{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--cyan);margin-top:4px}
#missionHud .payout{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#9c95ad;margin-top:2px;text-transform:uppercase}

#crosshair{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:30px;height:30px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:opacity .2s}
#crosshair .ch{position:absolute;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.9)}
#crosshair .ch.t{width:2px;height:7px;left:14px;top:0}
#crosshair .ch.b{width:2px;height:7px;left:14px;bottom:0}
#crosshair .ch.l{height:2px;width:7px;top:14px;left:0}
#crosshair .ch.r{height:2px;width:7px;top:14px;right:0}
#crosshair .dot{position:absolute;width:2px;height:2px;background:#fff;left:14px;top:14px;border-radius:50%}
#crosshair.enemy .ch{background:#ff5068}
#crosshair.focus .ch{background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--gold)}

#focusVignette{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,transparent 35%,rgba(255,209,102,.12) 62%,rgba(20,10,30,.42) 100%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
#focusVignette.on{opacity:1}
#damageVignette{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle,transparent 40%,rgba(190,0,20,.65) 100%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s}
#hitflash{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:#fff;opacity:0;transition:opacity .08s}
#subtitle{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(120px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(680px,86vw);text-align:center;opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #000,0 0 30px #000}
#subtitle.show{opacity:1}
#subtitle .who{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--pink2);margin-bottom:5px}
#subtitle .line{font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,17px);line-height:1.45;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#fff;font-weight:600}
#prompt{position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(62% + 20px);transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s}
#prompt.show{opacity:1}
#prompt .key{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(8,6,14,.86);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);padding:7px 13px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #000}
#prompt .key kbd{background:var(--pink);border-color:var(--pink);color:#0a0710;font-weight:800}
#toasts{position:absolute;top:calc(50% + 100px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.toast{background:rgba(8,6,14,.9);border-left:3px solid var(--cyan);padding:7px 14px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;animation:toastIn .3s ease-out;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #000}
.toast.bad{border-color:var(--red)}.toast.good{border-color:#7dff9c}.toast.money{border-color:var(--gold)}
@keyframes toastIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

#swapBanner{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:30%;text-align:center;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none}
#swapBanner.show{opacity:1}
#swapBanner .big{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(26px,5vw,54px);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#fff,var(--gold),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.8))}
#swapBanner .small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.36em;color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:4px}

#cinema{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s}
#cinema .bar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:9vh;background:#000}
#cinema .bar.t{top:0}.cinema .bar.b{bottom:0}
#cinema.on{opacity:1}

/* ---------------- overlays ---------------- */
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:80;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(4,3,8,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(9px);padding:18px;pointer-events:auto}
.sheet{width:min(560px,94vw);background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(24,18,38,.97),rgba(10,8,17,.98));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);box-shadow:0 30px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.8);padding:22px}
.sheet h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.1em;margin:0 0 2px;text-transform:uppercase}
.sheet .sub{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.26em;color:#9189a6;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:16px}
.sheet .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.sheet .row .v{color:var(--gold);font-family:var(--display);font-size:17px}
.sheet .row .v.cyan{color:var(--cyan)}.sheet .row .v.green{color:#7dff9c}
.sheet .actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{padding:10px 16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.15s}
.btn:hover{background:rgba(255,47,142,.2);border-color:var(--pink)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--pink);border-color:var(--pink);color:#0a0710;font-weight:800}
.btn.primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.1);background:var(--pink)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed}
.closeX{position:absolute;top:14px;right:16px;background:none;border:0;color:#8f88a3;font-size:22px;line-height:1}
.phoneWrap{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:90;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(4,3,8,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);pointer-events:auto}
.phone{width:min(360px,92vw);height:min(690px,88vh);background:#0b0912;border:10px solid #17131f;border-radius:38px;box-shadow:0 30px 120px rgba(0,0,0,.9),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.12);position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.phone:before{content:'';position:absolute;top:9px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:86px;height:21px;background:#050409;border-radius:12px;z-index:3}
.phoneScreen{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:36px 18px 20px;background:radial-gradient(130% 80% at 20% 0%,#261332 0%,#0d0a16 55%,#09070f 100%);scrollbar-width:none}
.phoneScreen::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.appHead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:16px}
.appLogo{font-family:var(--display);font-size:20px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.appLogo b{color:var(--pink)}
.statusBar{position:absolute;top:14px;left:22px;right:22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#bdb5d0;z-index:4}
.balanceCard{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#ff2f8e22,#38e8ff11);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.balanceCard:after{content:'';position:absolute;right:-30px;top:-30px;width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,47,142,.35),transparent 70%)}
.balanceCard .lab{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.26em;color:#a79fb9;text-transform:uppercase}
.balanceCard .amt{font-family:var(--display);font-size:34px;letter-spacing:.02em;margin:2px 0 4px}
.balanceCard .amt span{font-size:16px;color:#bdb5d0}
.balanceCard .acct{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#8e87a2}
.pillRow{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}
.pill{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#b6aec8;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.pill.hot{border-color:rgba(255,47,142,.5);color:var(--pink2)}
.appList{margin-top:6px}
.appRow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.appRow .k{color:#8e87a2;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.appRow .val{font-family:var(--display);font-size:16px;color:var(--gold)}
.phoneTabbar{display:flex;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);background:#0a0811;padding:8px 6px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
.phoneTabbar button{flex:1;background:none;border:0;color:#6f6880;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;align-items:center;padding:4px}
.phoneTabbar button i{font-style:normal;font-size:15px}
.phoneTabbar button.active{color:var(--pink2)}
.crimeBars{margin-top:8px}
.crimeBar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.crimeBar label{width:88px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9b94ae}
.crimeBar .t{flex:1;height:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.crimeBar .f{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--pink),var(--red))}
.phone .note{font-size:9px;line-height:1.6;color:#7f7893;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-top:14px}

.lockWrap{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:95;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(4,3,8,.7);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);pointer-events:auto}
.lockPanel{width:min(480px,92vw);background:rgba(10,8,17,.97);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);padding:24px;text-align:center}
.lockPanel h3{font-family:var(--display);letter-spacing:.12em;margin:0 0 2px;font-size:20px;text-transform:uppercase}
.lockPanel p{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8e87a2;margin:0 0 20px}
.lockTrack{height:44px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 2px,transparent 2px 22px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.lockZone{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;background:rgba(125,255,156,.26);border-left:1px solid #7dff9c;border-right:1px solid #7dff9c}
.lockNeedle{position:absolute;top:-4px;bottom:-4px;width:3px;background:var(--pink);box-shadow:0 0 16px var(--pink)}
.lockPins{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:14px 0 4px}
.pin{width:32px;height:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.pin.ok{background:#7dff9c;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(125,255,156,.6)}
.lockMsg{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cyan);height:15px;margin-top:8px}
.qteWrap{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:95;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(4,3,8,.4);pointer-events:auto}
.qteBox{text-align:center;background:rgba(10,8,17,.92);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);padding:24px 30px;box-shadow:0 20px 80px #000}
.qteBox h3{font-family:var(--display);letter-spacing:.12em;margin:0 0 4px;font-size:20px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--pink2)}
.qteBox p{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#a79fb9;margin:0 0 16px}
.qteKeys{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:12px}
.qteKeys .qk{width:54px;height:54px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);font-family:var(--display);font-size:21px;color:#8e87a2;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);transition:.16s}

- suspicion > 0 but not confirmed: white pulsing outlines? Hmm.

Do that: class white when visualContact, red otherwise. Suspicion stars shown dim white with .on? Maybe classes: confirmed red; unconfirmed white. Add pulse on white. BuckMe phone deposit: deposit all cash to bank; withdraw 500 if bank>=500.

Interact near pump with car: hold E? prompt "E Refuel & Repair $X" cost $60. If cash insufficient, toast. Gas station also repair health. Fuel price; for EV charge.

T near own car (personal). Store bags or conceal body (body count from kills not yet). Add body count when killing near?  b. Could add "Deposit cash via phone" step to teach BuckMe. Objective "Open phone (M) and deposit your cash" complete on deposit. reward.

 b. "Store the duffel in your trunk (T near personal car)" choose personal car marker; open trunk and store bag.

Reserve blocks and add manual structures.

Motel center (-120, 200) → gx=-2, gz=2 => block center (-120, 200). yes.

For east beach (x>240) pastel low 8-20. Downtown (dist<200) 25-95. Port Gellhorn industrial x<-260: warehouses 8-16 wide. Keys z>300: low 5-12.

- palm trees deterministic positions on blocks/sidewalks and outskirts.

uniforms topColor, bottomColor, sunDir, sunColor, time, cloudiness.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable GTA VI-inspired Leonida game in the existing repository, implementing the supplied world, protagonists, gameplay systems, and technical concepts.
- Validate the game in-browser and capture a screenshot.

## Requirements
- User requested a playable build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them upon completion.
- Requested systems include dynamic weather, dense city navigation, Jason/Lucia relationship and role swapping, combat/focus, vehicles and fuel/trunks, crime heat, economy, criminal profile, and AI.
- Screenshots for checks should be small JPEGs at most 1280px wide; read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a browser-based Three.js/Vite game titled “GTA VI — Leonida Dreaming.”
- Added a multi-mission Jason and Lucia story, synthesized audio, and game systems across modular source files.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the Vite project configuration and `index.html` UI.
- Added game modules for audio, world, vehicles, characters, missions, and the main game loop.
- Added follow-up fixes for crime reporting, vehicle shooting collision, UI key input, mission deposit checks, and vehicle summoning.
- Build was reported successful after code changes.

### Active
- Browser verification and screenshot review; the last action read `screenshots/cap/final-desktop.png`, but its content is unavailable in this summary.
- Check current build/server status and inspect browser console/runtime errors; earlier capture attempts reported issues that led to deleting `this.updatePauseLabels();`, followed by another capture attempt.

### Blocked
- Browser automation availability/status was unclear: `playwright-cli` and capture script attempts did not produce clearly reported successful screenshot validation.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the latest build output and runtime/browser console errors; fix any issues.
2. Run the game and complete a playable smoke test covering start, movement, interactions, and a mission objective.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot as requested.
4. Summarize assumptions and test results for the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, menus, and interaction screens.
- `src/main.js`: Main game state, controls, gameplay systems, and HUD.
- `src/world.js`: Leonida world, environment, weather, navigation.
- `src/vehicles.js`: Vehicle types and traffic systems.
- `src/characters.js`: Player characters and NPCs.
- `src/missions.js`: Mission chain and objectives.
- `src/audio.js`: Synthesized game audio.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and dependencies.
- `screenshots/cap/final-desktop.png`: Most recent captured image, read at the end of the prior work.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push was reported.
- Previous build command: `npm run build`.
- The last screenshot was PNG despite the user’s JPEG preference; validate and save a compliant JPEG for the next check.

import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'

const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()

const out = '/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots'
mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true })
const browser = await chromium.launch(config.browser.launchOptions)
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 } })
const errors = []
page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push(e.message))
page.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(m.text()) })
page.on('response', r => { if (r.status() >= 400) errors.push(`HTTP ${r.status()} ${r.url()}`) })

await page.goto('http://localhost:3000', { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 60000 })
await page.waitForTimeout(2500)
await page.click('#btnPlay')
await page.waitForTimeout(2500)

const before = await page.evaluate(() => ({
  state: window.game.state,
  x: window.game.player.position.x,
  z: window.game.player.position.z,
  mission: window.game.missions?.current?.title || window.game.missionTitle || null,
  objective: window.game.missions?.current?.objective || null,
  calls: window.game.renderer?.info?.render?.calls,
  triangles: window.game.renderer?.info?.render?.triangles,
  sceneChildren: window.game.scene?.children?.length,
  char: window.game.activeChar?.spec?.name || window.game.activeChar?.name || null
}))

await page.keyboard.down('KeyW')
await page.waitForTimeout(1300)
await page.keyboard.up('KeyW')
await page.waitForTimeout(300)

const after = await page.evaluate(() => ({
  x: window.game.player.position.x,
  z: window.game.player.position.z,
  calls: window.game.renderer?.info?.render?.calls,
  mission: window.game.missions?.current?.title || null,
  objective: window.game.missions?.current?.objective || null
}))

await page.keyboard.press('KeyM')
await page.waitForTimeout(500)
const phoneOpen = await page.evaluate(() => !document.getElementById('phone').classList.contains('hidden'))
await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
await page.waitForTimeout(400)

await page.screenshot({ path: join(out, 'leonida-check.jpg'), type: 'jpeg', quality: 78 })

console.log(JSON.stringify({ before, after, moved: Math.hypot(after.x - before.x, after.z - before.z).toFixed(2), phoneOpen, errors }, null, 2))
await browser.close()

import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'

const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()

const out = '/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots'
mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true })
const browser = await chromium.launch(config.browser.launchOptions)
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 } })
const errors = []
page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push(e.message))
page.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(m.text()) })

await page.goto('http://localhost:3000', { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 60000 })
await page.waitForTimeout(2200)
await page.click('#btnPlay')
await page.waitForTimeout(1600)

await page.evaluate(() => {
  const g = window.game
  g.activeChar.pos.set(g.personalCar.pos.x - 2, 0.27, g.personalCar.pos.z)
  g.activeChar.group.position.copy(g.activeChar.pos)
})
await page.waitForTimeout(400)
await page.keyboard.press('KeyF')
await page.waitForTimeout(1100)

// Stage the hero shot on the forecourt, facing the lit GAS & GO canopy.
await page.evaluate(() => {
  const g = window.game
  const car = g.personalCar
  car.pos.set(120, 0.3, 158)
  car.heading = Math.PI
  car.speed = 0
  g.camYaw = Math.PI
  g.camPitch = -0.10
  g.camDist = 8.4
  g.world.hour = 21.4
  g.world.setWeather('clear')
  if (g.activeChar.inVehicle) {
    g.activeChar.pos.copy(car.seatPosition(g.activeChar.seat))
    g.partner.pos.copy(car.seatPosition(g.partner.seat))
  }
  g.say('LUCIA', 'Pumps are lit. Card reader is probably skimming. Classic Leonida.', 4.5)
  g.updateMissionHud(g.missions.mission, g.missions.current, 12)
})
await page.waitForTimeout(2400)
await page.screenshot({ path: join(out, 'leonida-check.jpg'), type: 'jpeg', quality: 80 })
console.log(JSON.stringify({ errors, state: await page.evaluate(() => window.game.state) }))
await browser.close()

## GTA VI — Leonida Dreaming

A browser-based, third-person open-world crime sandbox built with Three.js and Vite. Play a five-mission Jason & Lucia story across a procedural Leonida: Palm Shade Motel, Ocean Beach, Port Gellhorn, and downtown Vice City.

### Run

```bash
npm install
npm run dev      # development server
npm run build    # production build in dist/
npm run preview  # preview the production build
```

### Controls

| Input | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `WASD` / arrows | Move / drive |
| Mouse | Look |
| `Shift` | Sprint |
| `E` | Interact, refuel, rob, enter interiors |
| `F` | Enter / exit vehicle |
| `X` | Swap driver and gunner seats |
| `Tab` | Switch protagonist (on foot) / swap seats (in car) |
| `Q` | Focus (bullet time, highlights threats) |
| `M` | BuckMe phone: bank, trunk, crime profile, settings |
| `T` | Open the personal car trunk |
| `Space` | Jump / handbrake |
| `R` | Reload |
| `1` `2` `3` | Pistol / SMG / shotgun |
| `Esc` | Pause |

Touch controls appear automatically on mobile, including a virtual stick, look pad, and action buttons.

### Systems

- Dynamic day/night cycle, weather, storms, wet streets, and neon lighting.
- Jason/Lucia role swapping with partner AI, driving, and gunner support.
- Vehicles with fuel, damage, repair, trunks, traffic, and carjacking.
- Weapons, focus mode, police heat, dispatch waves, witnesses, and crime profile.
- Cash/bank economy, duffel bags, fencing, deposits, and mission payouts.
- Five-mission story with waypoint HUD, rewards, and free roam after completion.
